title: Hero Squad Character Select Motion
summary: Motion-graphics character-select prompt for a hero battler roster, with role labels, weapon readability, UI states, and controller-safe timing.
prompt:
Create a 15 second in-engine character-select motion sequence for a colorful hero battler. Use Unreal Engine style rendering, candy-colored Japanese arcade art direction, and UI overlays that would be readable on controller, touch, and keyboard/mouse.

0-2s: Empty selection stage. Center reticle, thin-line HUD frame, particles, and status text: ROSTER SYNC, PLAYER SLOT 01, READY CHECK.

2-4s: Fox tactician enters on a hovering board. Show role chip TACTICIAN, mobility stat, support radius icon, and a short idle animation that communicates speed.

4-6s: Rabbit executioner swings a carrot weapon into a combat stance. Show weapon icon, cooldown ring, combo role, and damage-type color cue.

6-8s: Corgi commander appears with a friendly confident idle. Show command aura, squad buff icon, and co-op synergy tag.

8-15s: All three heroes lock into a party lineup. UI cycles through player cursor hover, confirm pulse, locked-in state, accessibility-safe color labels, and final versus-screen transition. Keep every overlay game-native: no corporate charts, no business metrics, only roster, role, weapon, ability, and readiness information.
